title: The Nightly Charge for a Guest Beyond Standard Occupancy, Resort Lodging
content:
What a Resort Lodging party pays for each guest beyond the unit type's standard occupancy turns on how the party is made up.

Where the party is larger than the unit type's standard occupancy and carries children as well as adults, each guest beyond the standard occupancy is charged at the family share of the unit type's extra person nightly charge, being 60 percent of it, for every night of the stay.

Where the party is larger than the unit type's standard occupancy, carries adults only and fills the unit type's maximum occupancy, each guest beyond the standard occupancy is charged at the full house share of that nightly charge, being 125 percent of it, for every night of the stay.

In every other case each guest beyond the unit type's standard occupancy is charged at the unit type's extra person nightly charge for every night of the stay.

## The two occupancy figures of each unit type

| Unit type | Standard occupancy | Maximum occupancy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 2 | 4 |
| Slopeside Studio | 2 | 4 |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 4 | 4 |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 4 | 6 |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 4 | 6 |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 6 | 8 |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 8 | 12 |

### Three hypothetical parties in a Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence

The unit type's standard occupancy is 4 and its maximum occupancy is 6.

A party of three adults and two children numbers 5, which is larger than the standard occupancy of 4, and carries children as well as adults. Each of the guests beyond the standard occupancy is charged at 60 percent of the unit type's extra person nightly charge for every night of the stay.

A party of six adults numbers 6, which is larger than the standard occupancy and fills the maximum occupancy of 6, and carries adults only. Each of the guests beyond the standard occupancy is charged at 125 percent of that nightly charge for every night of the stay.

A party of five adults numbers 5, which is larger than the standard occupancy but does not fill the maximum occupancy of 6, and carries no children. Each guest beyond the standard occupancy is charged at the unit type's extra person nightly charge itself for every night of the stay.
